title: KCSAN: data-race in bprm_execve / copy_fs (4)
two_threads_summary: execve thread A in bprm_execve writes fs->in_exec=0; clone(CLONE_FS) thread B in copy_fs reads in_exec under fs->lock. Race when in_exec is reset too late.
audit_notes: Fix reorders the assignment so it always happens within cred_guard_mutex's protection, before sibling threads can observe the half-finished state.
fix_commit_message:
af7bb0d2ca459f15cb5ca604dab5d9af103643f0
exec: fix the racy usage of fs_struct->in_exec

check_unsafe_exec() sets fs->in_exec under cred_guard_mutex, then execve()
paths clear fs->in_exec lockless. This is fine if exec succeeds, but if it
fails we have the following race:

	T1 sets fs->in_exec = 1, fails, drops cred_guard_mutex

	T2 sets fs->in_exec = 1

	T1 clears fs->in_exec

	T2 continues with fs->in_exec == 0

Change fs/exec.c to clear fs->in_exec with cred_guard_mutex held.
